title: Rebound and Sprint Conditioning
description: Players rebound their own shot and immediately sprint to the opposite basket before shooting again, blending conditioning with real basketball actions.

content.objective: Combine real basketball actions — shooting, rebounding, sprinting — into one continuous conditioning set.
content.setup: A player starts under one basket with a ball and a clear full-court lane.
instructions: Shoot a layup, rebound the ball yourself, then sprint-dribble the length of the court.
Shoot a layup at the far end, rebound it, then sprint back the other way.
Continue the cycle for a set number of makes or a set time limit.
Rest briefly between sets to recover before repeating.
coachingPoints: Keep good shooting and rebounding technique even as fatigue builds.
Sprint at genuine effort each length, not a conditioned jog.
Count makes, not just sprints, to keep the quality of the basketball actions high.
commonMistakes: Rushing the shot just to get to the sprint portion faster.
Losing dribble control while sprinting through fatigue.
Skipping the recovery interval instead of using it to reset.
content.safety: Make sure both baskets and the full-court lane are clear before starting.
